steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Aaaagh--!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Watch out! !

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I'm fine... It's just a scratch, don't worry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not good enough... At this rate, they're going to close in on us.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I've already found the weak point in their line, but without reinforcements, it's taking all we have just to hold them back!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Please hold out a bit longer! Focus your fire on the ranged enemies!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our Casters will take care of their vanguard!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Good, good! This is how things should be! Next up, F3, E5!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: This bloody brat...!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Excellent! Now, B4, B5!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The enemy is now trying to flank us!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Take two Defenders and a Sniper! Just keep them busy!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: And next! H2, H6!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: They... they're rushing our defensive line!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Vanguards, flush them out!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: That's right, let me see how you struggle!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Now, Casters. move to C7. Capture their Rook!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Enemy Casters have appeared! So far, they're hiding behind their Defenders!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's too late! Take cover!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Aaargghh!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Now be snuffed out, like flames before a storm!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is he really commanding his troops like that? How can he give such precise orders just by barking out chess moves?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those same disorderly thugs have been turned into an army under his command...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At this rate, he's going to keep exploiting the advantage he gets through his leadership...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: On the other hand, if we manage to suppress him, they'll fall into disarray!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Don't give them even the slightest opening!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Damn it, we're running out of time!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't allow ourselves to be stalled any longer!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is there some way to turn the tables... anything?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're going to be... Doctor's going to...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Gaaaaaaahh!!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Huh... What's going on? Why are people getting knocked into the air?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: ... the hell is that?
You guys sure took your sweet time. I even had time to relocate the civilians.
Out of my way!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Woah!!
Let's hit 'em even harder! Don't give the enemies a chance to regroup!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Nearl!!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I'm glad you're still safe, Amiya. Let's move.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Thank goodness you were deployed in this operation.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Using the signal flare was judicious. Seems like you've been having a rough time.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: You must be Dr. {@nickname}, right?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Radiant Knight, Nearl, at your service. Your chariot has arrived.
